citation: AviList Core Team. 2026. AviList: The Global Avian Checklist, v2026. https://doi.org/10.2173/avilist.v2026

source.note: The official XLSX is published on avilist.org. Direct download returned Cloudflare 403 from this environment. The Checklist Explorer JSON is AviList's own extract of the extended v2026 sheet (26 columns, sheet AviList v2026). Its per-order species totals match the counts published on the v2026 checklist page, including 11,172 species and 45 orders.
source.chineseNames: eBird taxonomy common names, locale zh_SIM (Chinese SIM), Cornell Lab of Ornithology, joined only on the Cornell species code AviList v2026 publishes when the species concept matches. Retrieved for this build. Where that name is absent, the previous Chinese name is kept on a 1:1 scientific-name match, or carried across a 1:1 rename.
